situation: Two old friends who have always disagreed about politics, texting while the news is on.
topic: Immigration: they are angry with each other, each calling the other's view heartless or naive, and neither backs down.

text: U see the news on immigration tonight? The debate
Which one. The minister or the opposition guy
The minister. Says the numbers have to come down
The numbers are high. And they're high because nobody built housing for the people already here
So we stop letting people in till the houses show up? Thats the plan
I want people to stop living in basements for 3 yrs waiting on a permit. I see it every week
And the guy wanting the hard cap is just saying what gets votes. Cutting people off and calling it compassion
Calling it compassion is what u do when u dont want to say the number out loud
The number is people. Thats the whole thing
Ok so ur fine with 3 people in a 2 bedroom in surrey
Im fine with people having a roof and I dont see why thats naive
Its not naive to have a roof. Its naive to think the roof shows up on its own
Sure. Whatever. Ur the one who sells houses so ur biased
And ur the one who wires them and never once asked who lives in them
Ha. Ok
Anyway. Did the panel job today. The guy in kits had a dog that wouldnt leave the basement. Took 2 hrs to get the breaker done
Dogs always have opinions about the basement
Ur not wrong
Saturday the 5th still good for the dinner? I asked the place if we could do 7
7 is fine. U getting the cake or am I
U get the cake. I get the card. Last time u forgot the card
I did not forget the card, the card was in the car
Sheila wants to come. She says she wont talk politics. I said good luck
Ill tell her the immigration thing is off the table. Ill keep my hands to myself
Ur hands have never been to myself. They hit the table
Lol. Ok
Did they say anything else about the housing plan at the end? I turned it off during the weather
They said itll be in the budget. Nobody believes it
I believe the part about the budget. Not the part about it being built
See thats the same thing we were arguing about 3 hrs ago
We can argue about it saturday. After the cake
Deal
Sheila asked if she can bring a dessert. I said ask the place first
Shes going to ask the place and then bring it anyway
Ill deal with it
Ok. Ill tell her to call them
Went to see my dad at the place in Richmond. He called me Rick the whole time. Rick was his brother
Oh Den. Did you let him keep calling you Rick
Yeah. Figured Rick would have wanted the coffee
Ha. Ok
Do you want to come for supper later. Im doing the chicken thing. Not the good one
Cant tonight. Got a call from a guy in Mount Pleasant, fridge breaker, he wants it done before his in laws come tomorrow
Ur going to do a breaker on a Sunday
Hes paying double
Ok. Tell the dog I said hi
Did the card get bought or do I need to
Card is bought. Its in the car
Dont start
Watching the hockey. Canucks lost to somebody in a shootout
Of course they did
Saturday. Cake first
Deal
Cant sleep
Go to bed Den
Did u sleep or just lie there
Lay there. Got up at 6 and did the coffee
Rick would be proud
Ur not funny before 9
Sheila called the place. They said dessert is fine if its not a cake. She says she has a cake
Of course she does
Tell her I already ordered one
U didnt order one
I will by 3
Called the bakery on Commercial. Chocolate. Not lemon
Lemon was ur idea last year and nobody ate it
Nobody ate it because it was in the car
Den
Its the card. Ill stop
Did the fridge guy in mount pleasant pay u or do I need to call somebody
Paid cash. Said he was sorry about the in laws. Didnt say which ones
Ha
Turned on the news for 5 min. Ur minister is still saying numbers
Not my minister
Ur the one who voted for him
I voted for the housing part
Saturday. Cake first
Deal
